ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৬) (Q. 26 to 30) : Read the following passage and answer the questions given below in the context of the passage.
There was once a fisherman who was also an excellent flute player. One day he took his flute and a fish-basket, jumped up on a rock and began to play his time. He was convinced that the fish would be enchanted by his music and leap into his basket willingly. Unfortunately, he did not catch a single fish. So he went home, brought his net and threw it into the water. He caught so many fish that his basket overflowed. ‘Stupid creatures!’ he exclaimed, as he watched the fish twist and jump into his net.’ You did not dance when I played my flute, but when I am not playing, you can’t stop dancing!’
26)The fisherman had excellence in:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
It is mentioned in the given paragraph - There was once a fisherman who was also an excellent flute player.
This line clearly indicates that the fisherman had excellence in playing the flute.
Hence, option 2 is correct.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৭) Choose the meaning of the underlined phrase according to the context of the passage:
One day he took his flute and a fish basket, jumped on a rock and began to play his time.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) To do some at the eleventh hour
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) To make up for the lost time
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) To deliberately do something slower than usual

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:

Synonym: stall, temporize, gain time, hang back, procrastinate, beat about the bush, drag one's feet, delay

As per the context of the passage, in order to catch fish, the fisherman climbed on the rock and started playing his flute slowly and calmly because fishing is a time-consuming process and it requires time and patience.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৮) Why did he play his flute?

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) The fish would dance on a rock
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) The fish loved the fish basket
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:

​"He was convinced that the fish would be enchanted by his music and leap into his basket willingly."
It is evident from the above statement that the fisherman was fool enough to think of catching fish by playing the flute.
Hence 1st option is an apt choice here.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) Why couldn’t he catch a single fish?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) The fish didn’t like his music
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) It is foolish to catch fish with a flute
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) His flute did not play well
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
After careful perusal of the given paragraph, one can easily find out that the fisherman behaved absurdly in the beginning by anticipating that the fish would jump into his net by listening to the flute played by him.
Hence 2nd option is an apt choice here.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) The word ‘enchanted’ used in the passage means -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Enchanted (adjective)
English Meaning: filled with delight; charmed.
Bangla Meaning: মোহিত; পুলকিত 
Example Sentence: The orchestra played classical favourites to an enchanted audience.

Source: Oxford Dictionary, Bangla Academy Dictionary
